_what_this_is: Conservative per-stage GPU-hour estimates for the matched-effectiveness diagnostic, derived from the measured run. Each estimate is BOTH an admission amount and a runtime bound, so it is deliberately above the observed cost.

conservatism.detection_throughput: 0.0718 s/image carried forward from results/audit_v1/protocol_cost_model.json; detect_report.json does not time the detector, so this figure is NOT re-measured here and is a carried assumption

reserve_reconciliation.rule: the reserve IS the sum of the test stage's own admitted estimates, so the two can never disagree
reserve_reconciliation.previous_inconsistency: 6 x 0.18 = 1.08 GPU-h of admissions against a 1.008 GPU-h reserve: the reserve could not cover the stage it existed to protect, and the shortfall would have appeared only after selection had already been paid for
